column1: # CharacterGear scoring weights (points per unit). The planner copies this file to data\CharacterGear_weights.tsv
# on first run; edit THAT copy to tune, then run the planner again.
# keys: defense = points per 1% less physical damage taken (armor per body part weighted by hit odds, level 7
#         Armor Self, damage resist, crit resist, crit damage resist - all with ACE's formulas)
#       offense = points per 1% more damage dealt from damage, crit and crit damage ratings (ACE formulas)
#       skill_<id> / attr_<id> = per point added by a spell on worn gear or a set bonus (normal-level spells count only
#       above the assumed level 7 buff of +40; cantrips and rare spells always count)
#       rating_376 / rating_379 = per point of Heal boost / Vitality rating (the other ratings are inside offense/defense)
#       hit_margin = how far an assumed monster's defense sits below your weapon skill x 1.17 (50 = ~82% hits);
#       evade_margin = same for its attack vs your Melee Defense x 1.17 (0 = 50% evades); monster_al = monster armor
#       for armor rending; ammo_damage = assumed arrow/bolt max damage for missile launchers.
#       Weapon skill and Melee Defense count through hit/evade chance (ACE SkillCheck), not as flat points.
#       other = per cantrip tier (Minor 1, Major 2, Epic 3, Legendary 4) for any other cantrip (wards, vitals...)
# Skill ids: 6 Melee D, 7 Missile D, 15 Magic D, 14 Arcane, 34 War, 43 Void, 41 Two-handed, 44 Heavy, 45 Light,
#            46 Finesse, 47 Missile, 48 Shield, 49 Dual wield, 50 Recklessness, 51 Sneak attack, 52 Dirty fighting
# Attribute ids: 1 Strength, 2 Endurance, 3 Quickness, 4 Coordination, 5 Focus, 6 Self
# Profile "all" applies to every profile unless the profile sets the same key. A combined profile like
# war+summoning uses the highest value any of its parts sets. Profiles: twohanded heavy light finesse missile war
# void life tinker crafter, extras summoning dualwield.
# dmg_slash ... dmg_lightning = damage-type mix the suit is scored against (relative; default 1 each = all types equal, the end goal being Legendary ward coverage for every type)
# spell_share = part of elemental damage that comes as spells (armor doesn't stop spells; protections and wards do). Default 0.5
# attack_seconds = time between attacks, for Aetheria surge uptime (default 2); surge_other = points per sigil level for
#   surges that aren't ratings (Regeneration, Affliction, Festering; default 2)
